answer_1.quote: CSAR is easily applicable to almost any emergent language due to the simplicity of the input format. In fact, the algorithm is general purpose enough to produce reasonable results in other domains, as we demonstrate with human language-based image captioning, machine translation, and word segmentation data.

answer_2.quote: We use F 1 score (harmonic mean of precision and recall) to assess the quality of an induced morpheme inventory given the ground truth inventory.
